name: itr-wala
description: File your Indian income tax return (ITR) from your terminal - deterministic tax engine, both regimes, AY 2026-27.

interface.shortDescription: File your Indian ITR from the terminal.
interface.longDescription: Reads Form 16/AIS, runs a deterministic tax engine for both regimes (every rupee computed by tested code, not by the model), reconciles TDS, and walks you through the e-filing portal. You always pay, submit, and e-verify yourself.
